entries.answer: Hey! I'm Grechelle — thanks for stopping by. Ask me about my projects, tech stack, experience, or how to reach me.

I'm Grechelle, a software developer with a background in UI/UX design. I started designing interfaces in Figma before moving into full-stack development, and today I enjoy building scalable applications while exploring AI-powered software.
You can reach me at grechelleab@gmail.com.
You can find my code on GitHub: https://github.com/matchellatte
I don't have a downloadable resume linked here just yet — the fastest way to get one is to email me at grechelleab@gmail.com or message me on LinkedIn.
I'm based in the Philippines and comfortable working with teams across time zones.
I'm open to full-stack and AI-integration roles, freelance builds, and select opportunities. Feel free to reach out at grechelleab@gmail.com.

My core stack is Next.js, React, and TypeScript on the frontend, with ASP.NET Core and Node.js/Express on the backend. For data I use PostgreSQL, Neon, MongoDB, and Prisma ORM, deployed with Docker and Vercel. I also work with the OpenAI API for LLM integration, and I still use Figma for UI/UX work.
Best ways to reach me: email at grechelleab@gmail.com, or LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/in/grechelle-ann-boneo/
You're welcome! Let me know if there's anything else you'd like to know about my work.
